premise: Drone can see far but can't carry; Rover can carry but can't see far; together, flash by flash, they bring back ice from the dark crater.
inspiration: Aesop's 'The Blind Man and the Lame Man', turned: two machines, each missing what the other has, and one very good team.

en-US.title: The Rover and the Drone
en-US.text: {geologist:enter} {geologist:face happy} Geologist had a job for two machines. Down in the wide, dark crater, something frozen was waiting. {drone:float loop 0.3} I can see far, said {drone:enter} Drone, but I can't carry a thing. {rover:enter} I can carry plenty, beeped Rover, {rover:pulse} but I only see a little way. [curious] So they made a plan. {drone:go to crater} Drone flew ahead into the shadows. {drone:live} Flash! It lit up the way. {rover:go to crater} Rover rolled after it, slow and steady, from flash to flash. {canvas:glints 10s} Then — something sparkled. {ice:enter} Ice! A wisp of frost {ice:live} curled up off it. {rover:live hold} Rover drilled out a chunk and loaded it up. {drone:pulse} {rover:live resume} Back they came, Drone lighting the way and Rover doing the carrying. {geologist:face happy} {geologist:hop} [excited] Perfect! said Geologist. {all:sparkle} Two halves of one very good team.

es-ES.title: El róver y el dron
es-ES.text: {geologist:enter} {geologist:face happy} Geólogo tenía un trabajo para dos máquinas. Allá abajo, en el cráter ancho y oscuro, algo helado esperaba. {drone:float loop 0.3} Yo veo lejos, dijo {drone:enter} Dron, pero no puedo cargar nada. {rover:enter} Yo cargo mucho, pitó Róver, {rover:pulse} pero solo veo un poquito. [curious] Así que hicieron un plan. {drone:go to crater} Dron voló delante, hacia las sombras. {drone:live} ¡Flash! Iluminó el camino. {rover:go to crater} Róver lo siguió, despacio y seguro, de flash en flash. {canvas:glints 10s} Y entonces… algo brilló. ¡{ice:enter} Hielo! {ice:live} Un hilito de escarcha subió de él. {rover:live hold} Róver taladró un trozo y lo cargó. {drone:pulse} {rover:live resume} Volvieron juntos, Dron iluminando el camino y Róver llevando la carga. {geologist:face happy} {geologist:hop} [excited] ¡Perfecto! dijo Geólogo. {all:sparkle} Dos mitades de un equipo buenísimo.

drill.prompt: a small rover drill whirring into icy gravel, a gritty buzz, short
